title: MetOffice Global 10km and UK 2km Deterministic Analysis
description: This contains data from the 2 year rolling archive of MetOffice 10km global deterministic model and 2km UK model analysis. The global model also contains 5 hours of forecast outputs, so both have hourly resolution for the full time period. Both start from 2024-01-01 and continue to the near-present. The data is in Icechunk format for easy access.
